title: Two boosts do not generally commute
promptMarkdown: In coordinates $(ct,x,y,z)$ let $K_x$ have entries $(K_x)_{01}=(K_x)_{10}=-1$ and zero otherwise, and let $K_y$ have $(K_y)_{02}=(K_y)_{20}=-1$. Verify each obeys $K^T\eta+\eta K=0$. Compute $[K_x,K_y]$. Expand $e^{aK_x}e^{bK_y}e^{-aK_x}e^{-bK_y}$ to its leading nonidentity order. Interpret the result and explain why a scalar velocity-addition rule along one line cannot describe arbitrary ordered boosts.
hintLadder: Compute only the entries connected through index 0.
Terms linear inaorb cancel in the four-factor product.
Compare the surviving spatial block with an antisymmetric rotation generator.
